questions.prompt: Which desktop environment's D-Bus interface are you targeting to get/focus the window?
questions.description: Wayland window management is compositor-specific. What gdbus command or compositor do you have in mind?

questions.prompt: You mentioned the active window name is 'Whisp'. What is the exact intended behavior?
questions.description: Should the system find a window named 'Whisp', focus it, and then inject? Or should it only inject if 'Whisp' is already active?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Find a window named 'Whisp', focus it via D-Bus, then inject the text.

options.label: Only inject if the currently active window is named 'Whisp'.

questions.prompt: What happens if the 'Whisp' window isn't found?
questions.description: How should the injection module handle this failure?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Fallback to standard ydotool injection on whatever window is active.

options.label: Fallback: Inject into the currently active window.
Abort: Log an error and do not inject text.
